overview.short: Jagatjit Palace in Kapurthala is an architectural marvel of Punjab, modeled after the Palace of Versailles and Fontainebleau.
overview.description: Jagatjit Palace, located in Kapurthala, Punjab, was built by Maharaja Jagatjit Singh in 1908. Inspired by French Renaissance architecture, the palace features opulent Durbar halls, exquisite plasterwork, European antiques, and French-style gardens. Today it stands as one of Northern India's most extraordinary royal landmarks.
